newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Under half Marco Polo Ardmore units taken.
newsitem.headline: Under half Marco Polo Ardmore units taken.

text.p: Only 49 of 104 condominium units in Marco Polo Development's luxury Ardmore Park complex were taken up at Saturday's public launch, the Straits Times said on Sunday.
The sale came after news on Friday that Singapore's private property price index fell two percent in the third quarter, the first such decline in six years.
Marco Polo Developments managing director David Lawrence was quoted as saying the response was pretty much what he expected.
But Lawrence also told the Straits Times that current queueing and balloting guidelines for selling residential projects should be removed in view of the soft property market.
He said a May 15 package of anti-speculation measures has been "totally effective and the Real Estate Developers Association of Singapore guidelines are not necessary now."
